reviews.outcome: Use only propositional claims. The prime-extension proof is for the enumerated countable language; finite-model construction is indicated and assigned as Exercise 15, and must be developed fully in the corpus. HA/arithmetic completeness, IQC completeness comments, intermediate-logic classification, modal translations and Heyting algebra chapters are outside adoption. Local [BDJ-IPC-01](source-errors/findings/BDJ-IPC-01.json) corrects a misplaced negation in the prose rule after Corollary 23; Example 25(1) already has the intended rule.
